page.layout: One printed page, scanned at an angle. Top: running head "LIBER I." with page number "301" at top right. Centre: woodcut diagram of a circle with zodiac signs and labels "C Æquatis. B Eccentrici. A Mundi." Below the diagram: chapter heading "CAPVT II." then a title in italic, then the body text in one column of paragraphs. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: genere: consequens est vt de generalibus
Affectio Planetæ est vel Prima vel Orta.
Prima affectio est motus: cuius hoc est theor-
Quod etsi Planeta quidam tardius, quidam
celerius moueatur, certo tamen annorum interuallo

page.notes: The diagram is a woodcut of concentric circles with the twelve zodiac signs around the outer ring and the labels C Æquatis, B Eccentrici, A Mundi. The first word "EXplicuimus" has a large woodcut initial E, rendered here as E followed by the word. The last line "uallo" is set indented at the right of the column. The scan is cut off at the left edge, so the first letters of several lines are missing; the text above is restored where the line continues from the visible part, e.g. "Planetarum" and "elerius" are read as printed "Planetarum" and "celerius" only where the scan shows them.
